variables.description: Public URL this instance is reachable at. Auto-filled from the deployment's Railway domain via the RAILWAY_PUBLIC_DOMAIN ref and used to build the GitHub OAuth callback — leave it as-is unless you front treg with a custom domain / CNAME, in which case set it to that domain.
variables.label: Public URL
variables.helpText: Resolved at deploy time to https://YOUR-DEPLOYMENT-DOMAIN. Set to your custom domain (with scheme) to override, e.g. https://treg.yourdomain.com.

variables.description: GitHub OAuth App Client ID for sign-in (recommended). Create at github.com/settings/developers. The callback URL to register is https://YOUR-DEPLOYMENT-DOMAIN/auth/github/callback.
variables.label: GitHub OAuth Client ID (recommended login)
variables.helpText: Gives every visitor a real identity on the registry without you needing to configure a mail provider. Requires a GitHub OAuth App whose callback is set to your deployment's /auth/github/callback.

variables.description: Secret for the GitHub OAuth app above.
variables.label: GitHub OAuth Client Secret
variables.helpText: Required for the GitHub login door to work. At least one identity provider (GitHub / Resend email) must be configured before first sign-in.

variables.description: Resend API key for email OTP sign-in + team invites. Requires a Resend-verified sending domain (SPF/DKIM).
variables.label: Resend API key (optional — email login)
variables.helpText: Only needed if you want users to log in by email OTP instead of (or in addition to) GitHub.

variables.description: From header for transactional email. Default: tools-registry <no-reply@treg.to> — change to your Resend-verified domain if you enable the email door.
variables.label: Email From header
